scope: HCMC greater-metro outer belt & day-trip ring
note: No individual creator/influencer attributions were established for this outer-belt wave. Every place is carried by institutional authority (Wikipedia + full article; UNESCO/Ramsar; national heritage relic) or by named credible outlets (Saigoneer, Rusty Compass, Atlas Obscura, Travelfish, official VNAT vietnam.travel / vietnamtourism.gov.vn / vietnamtourism.org.vn, Dong Nai & Binh Duong provincial government/press, Vietnam News, Tuoi Tre) recorded in SOURCES_HCMC_METRO.json. Per the no-fabrication rule, no creators, clips or follower counts were invented; a verifiable-creator pass can be layered later.
